# 1 Samuel Chapter 30 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **Book:** 1 Samuel | **Chapter:** 30

---

### Verse 2
- **EMET:** "And-they-captured the-women who [were]-in-it, from-small unto-great; they-did-not put-to-death anyone, but-drove [them] and-went on-their-way."
- **LOGOS:** "and had taken captive the women who were in it, both small and great. They did not kill anyone, but carried them off and went their way."
- **PNEUMA:** "and carried off the women and everyone else in it, young and old. They hadn't killed anyone but had taken them all as they moved on."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 3
- **EMET:** "And-came David and-his-men to-the-city, and-behold, [it was]-burned with-fire, and-their-wives and-their-sons and-their-daughters had-been-taken-capti..."
- **LOGOS:** "And when David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire, and their wives and sons and daughters had been taken captive."
- **PNEUMA:** "When David and his men arrived at the town and found it destroyed by fire and their wives, sons, and daughters taken captive,"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 4
- **EMET:** "And-David and-the-people who [were]-with-him lifted-up their-voice and-wept until there-was-no strength in-them to-weep."
- **LOGOS:** "Then David and the people who were with him raised their voices and wept until they had no more strength to weep."
- **PNEUMA:** "David and his men wept aloud until they had no strength left to weep."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 6
- **EMET:** "And-it-was-distressing to-David exceedingly, for the-people spoke of-stoning-him, for [the]-soul of-all the-people was-bitter, each over his-sons and-..."
- **LOGOS:** "And David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because all the people were bitter in soul, each for his sons and daughters. Bu..."
- **PNEUMA:** "David was in serious danger, because his men were so bitter over the loss of their sons and daughters that they talked of stoning him. But David found..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 8
- **EMET:** "And-inquired David of-YHWH, saying, "Shall-I-pursue after this raiding-band? Shall-I-overtake-it?" And-He-said to-him, "Pursue, for you-shall-surely o..."
- **LOGOS:** "And David inquired of the LORD, "Shall I pursue this raiding party? Shall I overtake them?" He answered him, "Pursue, for you shall surely overtake an..."
- **PNEUMA:** "and David asked the LORD, "Should I pursue this raiding party? Will I catch them?" The LORD answered, "Pursue them. You will certainly overtake them a..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 10
- **EMET:** "And-pursued David, he and-four-hundred men, and-stood two-hundred men who were-too-exhausted to-cross [the]-brook of-Besor."
- **LOGOS:** "But David pursued, he and four hundred men, for two hundred had been too exhausted to cross the brook Besor."
- **PNEUMA:** "David continued the pursuit with four hundred men, while two hundred who were too exhausted to cross the brook stayed there."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 13
- **EMET:** "And-said to-him David, "To-whom [do]-you [belong], and-from-where [are]-you?" And-he-said, "A-young-man, an-Egyptian [am]-I, servant of-a-man, an-Amal..."
- **LOGOS:** "And David said to him, "To whom do you belong? And where are you from?" He said, "I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite, and my master ab..."
- **PNEUMA:** "David asked him, "Who do you belong to? Where are you from?" He said, "I'm an Egyptian, the slave of an Amalekite. My master left me behind three days..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 14
- **EMET:** "We raided the-Negev of-the-Cherethites and-that which [is]-to-Judah and-the-Negev of-Caleb, and-Ziklag we-burned with-fire.""
- **LOGOS:** "We had raided the Negev of the Cherethites and that which belongs to Judah and the Negev of Caleb, and we burned Ziklag with fire.""
- **PNEUMA:** "We had raided the Negev of the Cherethites, the territory of Judah, and the Negev of Caleb. And we burned Ziklag.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 15
- **EMET:** "And-said to-him David, "Will-you-bring-me-down to this raiding-band?" And-he-said, "Swear to-me by-God that you-will-not put-me-to-death and-that you-..."
- **LOGOS:** "And David said to him, "Will you take me down to this raiding party?" And he said, "Swear to me by God that you will not kill me or deliver me into th..."
- **PNEUMA:** "David asked, "Can you lead me to this raiding party?" He answered, "Swear to me by God that you won't kill me or hand me back to my master, and I'll t..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 16
- **EMET:** "And-he-brought-him-down, and-behold, they [were]-spread-out over-[the]-face of-all the-land, eating and-drinking and-feasting [chogegim] with-all the-..."
- **LOGOS:** "And when he had taken him down, behold, they were spread out over all the land, eating and drinking and celebrating because of all the great spoil the..."
- **PNEUMA:** "He led them down, and there were the Amalekites — scattered across the countryside, eating, drinking, and celebrating the enormous plunder they had ta..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 18
- **EMET:** "And-David recovered all that [the]-Amalekites had-taken, and-his-two wives David rescued."
- **LOGOS:** "David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and David rescued his two wives."
- **PNEUMA:** "David recovered everything the Amalekites had taken, including his two wives."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 19
- **EMET:** "And-nothing was-missing for-them, from-small and-unto great, and-unto sons and-daughters, and-from-spoil and-unto all that they-had-taken for-themselv..."
- **LOGOS:** "Nothing was missing, whether small or great, sons or daughters, spoil or anything that had been taken. David brought back everything."
- **PNEUMA:** "Nothing was missing — young or old, sons or daughters, plunder or anything else they had stolen. David brought it all back."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 20
- **EMET:** "And-took David all the-flocks and-the-herds; they-drove before that livestock and-said, "This [is the]-spoil of-David.""
- **LOGOS:** "And David took all the flocks and herds, and the people drove the livestock before him and said, "This is David's spoil.""
- **PNEUMA:** "He also captured all the flocks and herds, and his men drove them ahead of the other livestock, shouting, "This is David's plunder!""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 22
- **EMET:** "And-answered every evil and-worthless man [ish beliya'al] from-the-men who went with-David and-said, "Because they-did-not go with-us, we-will-not giv..."
- **LOGOS:** "Then all the wicked and worthless fellows among the men who had gone with David said, "Because they did not go with us, we will not give them any of t..."
- **PNEUMA:** "But some troublemakers among the men who had gone with David said, "Since they didn't go with us, we won't share the plunder with them. Each man can t..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 23
- **EMET:** "And-said David, "You-shall-not do so, my-brothers, with-that-which YHWH has-given to-us, and-He-guarded us and-gave the-raiding-band that-came against..."
- **LOGOS:** "But David said, "You shall not do so, my brothers, with what the LORD has given us. He has preserved us and given into our hand the raiding party that..."
- **PNEUMA:** "David replied, "No, my brothers — you must not do this with what the LORD has given us. He protected us and handed the raiders over to us."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 24
- **EMET:** "And-who will-listen to-you in-this matter? For as-the-share of-the-[one]-going-down into-the-battle, so [shall be]-the-share of-the-[one]-staying by-t..."
- **LOGOS:** "Who would listen to you in this matter? For as the share of him who goes down into the battle, so shall be the share of him who stays by the baggage. ..."
- **PNEUMA:** "Who is going to agree with you on this? The share of the man who stayed with the supplies is to be the same as the share of the man who went into batt..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 25
- **EMET:** "And-it-was from-that day and-onward, and-he-set-it [as]-a-statute and-[as]-an-ordinance for-Israel until this day."
- **LOGOS:** "And it was so from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day."
- **PNEUMA:** "David made this a binding rule for Israel from that day on, and it is still in effect today."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 27
- **EMET:** "to-those in-Beth-el, and-to-those in-Ramoth of-the-Negev, and-to-those in-Jattir,"
- **LOGOS:** "to those in Bethel, to those in Ramoth of the Negev, to those in Jattir,"
- **PNEUMA:** "He sent gifts to those in Bethel, Ramoth Negev, and Jattir;"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 29
- **EMET:** "and-to-those in-Racal, and-to-those in-the-cities of-the-Jerahmeelites, and-to-those in-the-cities of-the-Kenites,"
- **LOGOS:** "to those in Racal, to those in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, to those in the cities of the Kenites,"
- **PNEUMA:** "to those in Racal, the Jerahmeelite towns, and the Kenite towns;"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.

— SOPHIA
